header.title: Members
header.subtitle: These people can read all private feedback and security issues, and can add others here — being able to edit this roster is being able to open the door for yourself.
header.subtitleTitle: These people can read all private feedback and security issues, and can add others here — being able to edit this roster is being able to open the door for yourself. The "deployment config" group comes from the deployment config (PLATFORM_ADMIN_HANDLES) and cannot be removed on this page: a roster that can be emptied here has no way back, so changing it takes server access.

row.noAccountTitle: This handle has no account on the platform (or the account was deleted) — check the spelling in the deployment config; changing it takes server access
row.agentBadgeTitle: Agents cannot perform management actions, so this row's permission is unusable — check this name in the deployment config

empty.root: Nobody in the config (normal for local dev; required for deployment)
empty.added: No admins have been added on this page — everyone on the roster comes from the deployment config.

addDialog.title: Add admin
addDialog.hint: People added here can immediately read private feedback and security issues, and can add others themselves.

confirm.title: Remove admin
confirm.body: Remove {handle} from the roster? They will immediately lose access to private feedback and security issues, and can no longer add people here.
